manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed up and its velocity-time line is shown beside it. At the top the velocity is zero but the slope stays -g.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises and falls along a height ruler while a marker moves along the velocity-time line. The velocity arrow shrinks to zero at the top, but the acceleration arrow stays constant.
